properties.name: compare_designs has no reply budget where detect_gaps and reviewed_gaps both do — diffing two 9-16 MB exports returns an unusable reply, and a user wrote a script instead
properties.statement:
REPORTED 2026-09-13 by @ajs, met while working in flo2. Filed by them as friction.

compare_designs takes no budget_chars. detect_gaps and reviewed_gaps both do. Diffing two exports of 9-16 MB therefore returns a reply no client can use, and the user's response was to write their own script.

⭐ THEIR OWN FRAMING, AND IT IS THE PART THAT MATTERS: "the bounded form is what's missing, not the tool." The computation is right; only the reply is unusable. That distinction is what separates this from a feature request.

THIS IS A KNOWN CLASS, NOT A NEW ONE. fact:defect-graph-report-outgrows-its-own-reply-linearly records the same shape, and the bounding those two gap tools carry was added for exactly this reason — detect_gaps's own documentation says the failure it exists to stop "is not a slow call, it is the CLIENT refusing the reply, at which point the session sees a wall of harness text and reflow2 never gets to suggest narrowing." compare_designs was not swept when the others were.

🛑 THE SWEEP-SHAPED HAZARD, which is why the class link is drawn rather than left implied: fact:the-parallel-batch-class-recurred-because-only-its-instance-was-fixed records what happens when a class is fixed one instance at a time. Bounding compare_designs alone would repeat it. The honest fix asks which OTHER read tools return an unbounded reply, and answers that before touching this one.

WHAT A REPLACEMENT COSTS THE USER MEANWHILE: a hand-written script, outside the design, that nothing can read or check — the same shape as a private translator kept outside the graph.
